name: signature-map
description: Lightweight code-declaration index for fast, low-token navigation: a Go generator builds signatures.json (types and callables with signatures, doc comments, and line numbers across Swift, Objective-C, C/C++, Kotlin, Java, JS/TS, Python, Ruby, and shell), and the sigmap CLI refreshes the index, queries declarations by name or regex, opens code around matches, and diagnoses index health.

interface.shortDescription: Index and query code declarations fast.
interface.longDescription: Signature Map gives the host agent a declaration-first navigation workflow for medium and large repositories: an incremental Go generator indexes types and callables into signatures.json, and the bundled sigmap CLI answers exact-name and regex declaration queries, opens source with bounded context around matches, and runs doctor checks on index health, so the agent reads targeted snippets instead of scanning whole files.
capabilities: Incremental repo-wide declaration indexing into signatures.json
Exact-name and regex declaration search with kind, subtree, and limit filters
Bounded-context source opening around declarations and file:line locations
Batch snippet extraction from selector lists
defaultPrompt: Use Signature Map to find where this symbol is declared in the repo.
Use Signature Map to survey this module's API surface before editing it.
Use Signature Map to open the code around these declarations with context.
